breakpoints.note: The staged witness begins with the valid DWG version code `AC1013`, so `dwg_decode()` routes it into the exact vulnerable parser `decode_R13_R2000()` instead of rejecting it as non-DWG input.

First project-code materialization of vulnerability-relevant parser state on the witnessed path. The decoded section count drives allocation and iteration of the section locator table, ensuring slot 1 is parsed as the later-used Classes descriptor.

The vulnerable Classes-entry path copies the attacker-controlled section start into `dat->byte` and then proceeds to the sentinel probe without the patch's missing rejection `dat->byte +16 > dat->size`, so a one-past-end section start is treated as if a 16-byte sentinel were available.
